title: Playboi Carti — ILoveUIHateU — automatic game-instrument cover
description: Native-time symbolic automatic transcription revoiced with game/GM instruments; no source samples or vocals in synthesis.

analysis.palette: soft saw / FM keys / polysynth / synth bass

source_transcription.performance_timing: Native decoded source seconds, complete input including lead-ins/fades/tails
source_transcription.salience_time_note: Use explicit time_seconds. t(frame)=floor(frame/142)*36164/22050 + (frame%142)*256/22050. No global time stretch.
source_transcription.timing_policy: Exact source sample-window origins; per-window retained-frame hops; recovered complete decoded tail
source_transcription.primary_view_note: HPSS removes many percussive transients but retains mixed vocals/instruments. Other views are alternate evidence, not extra simultaneous score parts; select/deduplicate before rendering.
source_transcription.input_state: Frozen after native-timing repair; machine candidates remain unverified

drum_analysis.method: HPSS-masked log spectral-flux bands; no quantization or beat filling
drum_analysis.thresholds: adaptive local median/MAD plus source-band quantile
drum_analysis.confidence: heuristic attack candidates, not verified source/stem drum transcription
limitations: Pitched plucks, vocal consonants or bass attacks may produce false drum candidates.
Quiet or overlapping percussion may be missed; no exact kit separation is claimed.

transcription.performance_timing: Native decoded source seconds, complete input including lead-ins/fades/tails
transcription.bass_register_note: Raw21..60 retained to avoid erasing genuine sub fundamentals; bounded_bass_notes offers28..60. Rendering may fold a true sub up an octave, and must document that adaptation.
transcription.salience_time_note: Use explicit time_seconds. t(frame)=floor(frame/142)*36164/22050 + (frame%142)*256/22050. No global time stretch.
transcription.timing_policy: Exact source sample-window origins; per-window retained-frame hops; recovered complete decoded tail

separate_bass_pass.role: Only the low-register monophonic bass is taken from this separate band-limited pass; no blind note union.

bass_f0_candidate_validation.rule: Independent low-band YIN breaks ties only when valid periodic F0 matches an existing note+bend within0.85semitones; no notes or times generated.

analysis.foreground_role_assignment: Weighted nonoverlapping native-time note path; other retained pitches remain in counter/harmony voices.
analysis.timing: Native model/transient timestamps retained without tempo grid or source trimming; bpm120 is an export timebase only.
uncertainty: Automatic transcription of a dense full mix is not a complete or exact transcription.
Vocal, bass, chord and percussion source attribution is uncertain unless explicit stem labels were supplied.
Raw deep bass pitches are retained without octave folding; unresolved model octave errors remain possible. Overlapping candidates are resolved to one active note.
Raw Basic Pitch bend bins drive only the resolved monophonic bass; other GM voices use equal-tempered note centers.
No ground-truth score or human listening validation is available.
analysis.provenance_note: Input01 metadata was finalized after rendering; a fresh build_score comparison proved all2958 symbolic events identical. Only provenance metadata/hash was refreshed; audio and MIDI are unchanged.
